• 💧 Water near the root zone rather than frequently wetting the leaves.
• ☀️ Increase monitoring during hot weather.
• 🌧️ Avoid unnecessary watering after sufficient rainfall.
• 🪴 Use pots with drainage holes for container-grown tomatoes.
